Internal Grade E/EB9 Experian Cyber Fusion Centre are looking for a Senior Insider Risk Specialist to support the global Insider Risk Management Program by advancing Data Loss Prevention (DLP) governance, business engagement, and insider risk detection capabilities. Knowledge of insider risk, data protection, cybersecurity governance, and risk management practices. Experience evaluating business risk and applying governance principles to security controls, policy reviews, and exception management.
